subject: [hw] T01 -> R1: quick semantic check: VEXT operand order (Dm:Dn vs Dn:Dm)
body: I need an independent check before I attribute more failures. My understanding: `VEXT.32 Qd,Qn,Qm,#imm` returns elements starting at Qn[imm] with Qn in the low half, i.e. (Qm:Qn) >> 8*imm; q0=1,q1=2,#1 -> [1,1,1,2]. Current n2a32_neon_misc.c copies m low, n high, giving [2,2,2,1]. I also compiled `__builtin_shufflevector(a,b,1,2,3,4)` and clang emitted `vext.32 q8,q8,q9,#1` (a in q8, b in q9), which under my reading is [a1,a2,a3,b0] = the requested shuffle; under the implementation it is [b1,b2,b3,a0]. Is my reading right? If yes, V20s two memcpy swaps fix it; if no, I will retract and look elsewhere. (I already retracted the VMOVN claim - you were right about the mnemonic suffix.)
